# Planning Brief - 2026-08-25

**Research Source**: `.github/research/2026-08-25-research.md`

## Executive Summary

Today's research surfaced 1 high-value correctness fix and 1 defensive hardening opportunity from Cline's latest commits. The actionable item is platform-native line endings for new files (MODERATE ~4h), which prevents git diff pollution on Windows when agents create files with Unix line endings in Windows projects. The secondary item requires investigation: search tool OOM protection (MODERATE ~6h IF vulnerable).

## Development Plan

### Priority 1: Platform-native line endings (MODERATE ~4h)

**Problem**: `src/tool/tools/write.ts` hardcodes `\n` line separators for all new files. On Windows projects using `\r\n` (CRLF), this causes git to flag entire files as changed when only line endings differ, polluting diffs and causing merge conflicts.

**Solution**: Use platform-native `os.EOL` (Windows: `\r\n`, Unix/Mac: `\n`) as the default line ending for newly created files. When overwriting existing files, preserve their original line ending style.

**Value**: High correctness benefit for Windows users. Cross-platform tooling should respect platform conventions. Fixes spurious git diffs.

**Files**: `src/tool/tools/write.ts`, `src/tool/tools/__tests__/write.agentsmd.test.ts`, add new `src/tool/eol-normalizer.ts` helper.

### Priority 2: Search tool OOM protection (MODERATE ~6h IF vulnerable)

**Problem**: Cline's `search_codebase` tool crashed on giant single-line files (trace dumps, minified JS) because ripgrep's `--json` mode buffered all stdout into memory. Multi-hundred-MB single-line files caused `RangeError: Out of memory`, killing the process.

**Solution IF vulnerable**: Add 10MB stdout buffer cap, early abort, and line truncation (2000 chars) to prevent OOM. Requires investigation first: `src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts` uses ripgrep but may already stream incrementally or have size limits.

**Value**: Defensive coding - tools should not crash the process on legitimate project files. Medium priority (needs investigation to confirm vulnerability).

**Files**: `src/tool/tools/codesearch.ts` (investigation), potential new `src/tool/tools/__tests__/codesearch-oom.test.ts`.
